recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, atmospheric illustration of a cobbler's workbench bathed in natural light from a diamond-paned window, featuring parchment scrolls, leatherworking tools, and ink pots in a rustic, historical setting.
coreVisualRelationships: Light source from the right window illuminating the central scroll
Vertical tools on the left wall balancing the diagonal window panes
Warm wood textures contrasting with the cool white of the parchment
Text positioned in the upper left quadrant within the darkest shadow area
coreInvariants: Terracotta ink pots and metal calipers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The workbench occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, with the window filling the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit, partially unrolled scroll in the center foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright window light, across the scroll, to the dark tools on the left, then up to the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, shadowed wall behind the tools provides high-contrast space for the title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ochres for wood and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cream and off-white for the parchment and window light.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Terracotta red for small pots and the outer border frame.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between light and shadow.

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke weights with a hand-drawn feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a pointed, peaked top
The 'K' has a curved leg that mirrors the 'R'
The 'S' has an elongated bottom tail

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the darkest area for maximum legibility

graphicDevices: Thin horizontal underline beneath the text
Solid terracotta border framing the entire image

candidateDirections.reason: Similar high-waisted structure and flared serifs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a detailed illustration of a 17th-century cobbler's workshop. Focus on a wooden workbench with a large unrolled parchment scroll in the center. To the right, a diamond-paned window lets in bright morning light. On the left, leatherworking tools hang on a dark wooden wall. Use a muted earth-tone palette with colored pencil and watercolor textures. Frame the image with a solid terracotta red border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom-lettered display text in the upper left corner. Use an off-white color and a decorative serif style with flared terminals and high crossbars. Add a thin horizontal line directly beneath the text.

verificationChecks: Is the light source consistent with the window?
Does the text have a hand-drawn, organic feel?
Are the tools historically accurate to leatherworking?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the sketches on the scroll
Specific tools displayed on the wall

mustAchieve: Clear distinction between light and shadow

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the dark background
Verify the presence of the horizontal underline
Confirm the parchment looks aged and rolled
Check for a consistent hand-drawn illustration style
recipe.reuseFormula: Historical Workshop Scene + Natural Window Light + Parchment Subject + Decorative Serif Overlay + Earth Tone Palette
